description: The file defines API routes related to user notifications, including fetching notifications, marking individual notifications as read, and marking all notifications as read. It uses FastAPI and references notification and user models, as well as notification services.

methods.name: get_notifications( unread_only: bool = Query(False, description="Get only unread notifications"), current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Fetches notifications for the current user, optionally only unread ones.

methods.name: mark_notification_read( notification_id: str, current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Marks a specific notification as read.

methods.name: mark_all_notifications_read(current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Marks all notifications as read for the current user.

ctags.name: get_notifications
ctags.signature: ( unread_only: bool = Query(False, description="Get only unread notifications"), current_user: UserResponse = Depends(get_current_user) )
